# NERM endpoints in detail

Every NERM request and response body is wrapped in a key named after the resource (`{"profile": {...}}`, `{"profiles": [...]}`, `{"advanced_search": {...}}`). The wrapper is shown as `Body: {key: Type}`.

## v1 — base `https://{tenant}.nonemployee.com/api`

### advanced search

#### GET /advanced_search

`getAdvancedSearch` — Get saved advanced search queries

- Returns 200: {advanced_search: array of AdvancedSearch}

#### POST /advanced_search

`submitAdvancedSearch` — Save an advanced search query

Save an advanced search query for later use

- Body: `{advanced_search: AdvancedSearch-2}`
- Returns 200: {advanced_search: AdvancedSearch}

#### POST /advanced_search/run

`searchAdvancedSearch` — Run profiles advanced search

Run an advanced search for profiles, without saving the query

- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — The maximum number of items to return.
  - `offset` (query) — The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.
  - `order` (query) — The field to order results by.
- Body: `{advanced_search: AdvancedSearch-2}`
- Returns 200: {profiles: array of Profile}

#### PATCH /advanced_search/{id}

`patchAdvancedSearch` — Update a saved advanced search

Update a saved advanced search query

- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the object to retrieve, update, or delete
- Body: `{advanced_search: AdvancedSearch-3}`
- Returns 200: {advanced_search: AdvancedSearch}

#### GET /advanced_search/{id}/run

`searchAdvancedSearchbyID` — Run a saved advanced search

Run a saved advanced search query

- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the object to retrieve, update, or delete
  - `limit` (query) — The maximum number of items to return.
  - `offset` (query) — The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.
  - `order` (query) — The field to order results by.
- Returns 200: {profiles: array of Profile}

### audits

#### POST /audit_events/query

`search` — Query for Audit events

This endpoint provides a search engine for Audit Events by optionally combining subject_type, type, and subject_id to narrow down the audit events. A Subject Type of Profile links up to the AuditableProfile types. An Subject Type of WorkflowSession links up to the AuditableWorkflow types. An Subject Type of Get/Post/Patch/Delete links up to the AuditableApi types. The remaining Subject Types link up to the ActiveRecord types (configuration changes). - Any workflow audit event created as of…

- Body: `{audit_events: object}`
- Returns 200: {audit_events: array of AuditEvent}

- Returns 200, no body

### identity proofing results

#### GET /identity_proofing_results

`getIdentityProofingResults` — Get identity proofing result data

Retrieves identity proofing result data in bulk from Lifecycle

- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — The maximum number of items to return.
  - `offset` (query) — The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.
  - `order` (query) — The field to order results by.
  - `profile_id` (query) — Profile ID to filter by
  - `workflow_session_id` (query) — Workflow Session ID to filter by
  - `result` (query) — one of pass, fail — ID Proofing Result to filter by
  - `metadata` (query) — default False — Returns batching metadata in the response. This includes `total` as the total quantity, `next` as the path of the following query url, `limit` and `after_id` (if requested) with the next following…
- Returns 200: {identity_proofing_results: array of IdentityProofingResult, _metadata: Metadata}

### isc accounts

#### GET /isc/accounts

`getSchemaMappedProfilesCollection` — Get Profiles

Retrieve schema-mapped profiles collection. It returns a collection of stored profiles, optionally using schema-mapped field names if requested.

- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — The maximum number of items to return.
  - `offset` (query) — The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.
  - `use_schema` (query) — default False — The use_schema parameter returns schema-mapped field names in the Profiles API response when set to true.
  - `override_sync_toggle` (query) — default False — The override_sync_toggle parameter returns all non-employee and assignment profiles regardless of the sync status when set to true.
  - `category` (query) — one of non-employee, assignment — Filters profiles by profile type category
  - `status` (query) — one of active, inactive, on leave, terminated — The status of the profile. It can be multiple values with comma separated.
- Returns 200: {profiles: array of Profile, _metadata: MetadataWithAfterId}

#### GET /isc/accounts/{id}

`getSingleSchemaMappedProfile` — Get Profile

It returns a single stored profile, optionally with schema-mapped field names.

- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the object to retrieve, update, or delete
- Returns 200: {profile: Profile}

#### PATCH /isc/accounts/{id}

`updateProfile` — Update Profile

Updates a profile only through ISC schema-mapped attributes, performs a reverse mapping to match the NERM attributes to update.

- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the object to retrieve, update, or delete
- Body: `{profile: object}`
- Returns 200: {profile: Profile}

The upload must not attempt to include the file name or its content type as a other form or JSON as parameters. #### GET /workflow_sessions

`getWorkflowSessions` — Get workflow sessions

- Parameters:
  - `limit` (query) — The maximum number of items to return.
  - `offset` (query) — The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.
  - `order` (query) — The field to order results by.
  - `profile_id` (query) — Profile ID to filter by
  - `uid` (query) — Workflow session user-specified identifier (UID) for filtering
  - `workflow_id` (query) — Workflow ID for filtering
  - `requester_id` (query) — Requester ID for filtering
  - `status` (query) — one of waiting on workflow, identity proofing completed, new, closing, pending request, requested, pending approval, approved, pending notification, notified, pending review, reviewed, pending trigger, stored procedure, pending status change, status changed, pending update, non employee updated, non employee created, pending creation, rejected, pending assignment, assigned, default, failed, un assigned, auto assigned, ldap provided, pending ldap, pending fulfillment, pending stored procedure, pending courion add, fulfilled, pending courion update, courion add, pending courion_extend, courion update, pending courion terminate, courion extend, pending profile select, courion terminate, batch completed, profiles selected, answered questions, pending questions, attempting to start workflow, started workflow, profile check complete, completed, processing, pending set attribute, invitation sent, action skipped, api request sent, attribute set, disabled, duplicates resolved, soap request sent, checking for duplicates, pending identity proofing, closed, workflow changed — filter by workflow session status
  - `metadata` (query) — default False — Returns batching metadata in the response. This includes `total` as the total quantity, `next` as the path of the following query url, `limit` and `after_id` (if requested) with the next following…
- Returns 200: {workflow_sessions: array of WorkflowSession, _metadata: Metadata}

#### POST /workflow_sessions/{id}/upload/{attribute_id}

`submitWorkflowSessionUpload` — Uploads workflow session attachment

Uploads a new attachment attribute value to a workflow session. The upload must be a FORM data type; this is not a JSON API. The upload must include the binary content of the payload under the 'file' named form element. The upload must not attempt to include the file name or its content type as a other form or JSON as parameters. The upload must not attempt to upload the file body as the POST body payload; it has to arrive as a FORM parameter. Do not use a `File/Binary` payload type for the…

- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the object to retrieve, update, or delete
  - `attribute_id` (path, required) — The id of the attachment attribute
- Body: `{file: string}`
- Returns 200: {url: string}

## v2025 — base `https://{tenant}.nonemployee.com/api/v2025`

### delegations

#### GET /delegations

`` — List delegations

Returns a list of delegation records, optionally filtered by delegate, delegator, or expiration status.

- Parameters:
  - `delegate_id` (query) — default False — Filter by delegate ID
  - `delegator_id` (query) — default False — Filter by delegator ID
  - `expired` (query) — default False — Filter by expiration status (true for expired, false for not expired)
  - `limit` (query) — The maximum number of items to return.
  - `offset` (query) — The number of items to skip before starting to collect the result set.
  - `include` (query) — default  — Include related resources body. For example, 'include=delegator,delegate'.
- Returns 200: {delegations: array of Delegation}

#### POST /delegations

`` — Create a delegation

Create a new delegation record.

- Body: `{delegation: Delegation-2}`
- Returns 201: {delegation: Delegation-3}

#### GET /delegations/{id}

`` — Get a single delegation

Returns a single delegation record by its ID.

- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the object to retrieve, update, or delete
- Returns 200: {delegation: Delegation}

#### PATCH /delegations/{id}

`` — Update a delegation

Update an existing delegation record.

- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the object to retrieve, update, or delete
- Body: `{delegation: object}`
- Returns 200: {delegation: Delegation-3}

#### DELETE /delegations/{id}

`` — Delete a delegation

Delete an existing delegation record.

- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the object to retrieve, update, or delete
- Returns 200, no body
